# Code of conduct

Bashou is for people learning the terminal, often for the first time. Everyone who takes part, in
issues, pull requests or reviews, keeps it a place where beginners dare to ask.

- **Be kind and patient.** No question is too basic. Explain, don't mock.
- **Talk about the work, not the person.** Disagree with an idea by saying what you'd do instead.
- **Credit and consent.** Share only your own work, or work you have the right to share.
- **No harassment**: no insults, no discrimination of any kind, no sexual content, no personal
  information about others.

Something wrong? Contact the maintainer privately through GitHub
([@IAmAStealer](https://github.com/IAmAStealer)). Messages that break these rules are removed, and
repeated or serious cases lead to a ban from the project.
